Paper Name: Hydrogen Energy Storage Based Green Power Plant in Seashore of Bangladesh: Design and Optimal Cost Analysis
NOTES: TOTAL ANNUAL LOAD DEMAND reported as 2,920,000 kWh/yr (also listed as 2,917,683 kWh served in Table V). LCOE not reported; COE reported as 'per unit cost' in conclusion. LPSP not reported. rated_PV given as total system capacity (2500 kW). v_cut_in/v_rated not reported. Cap_FC not applicable (hydrogen generator/genset used instead of fuel cell). Cap_DG: generator is hydrogen-fueled (3000 kW Genset), not diesel generator. H_min/H_max not reported. f_0/f_1 not reported. eta_PV not reported (derating factor 80% given, not efficiency). eta_INVT and H2_LHV not reported. Capital costs (c_PV, c_WT, c_H2, c_EL_cap, c_DG_cap, c_INVT) are total system Net Present Costs from Table VI, not per-unit costs. c_DG reported as fixed generation cost ($0.43/hr), not operating cost. c_DG_FUEL: generator uses hydrogen fuel, not diesel. O&M values (om_PV, om_WT, om_H2, om_EL, om_DG, om_INVT) are annualized O&M costs from Table VII. Exchange rate: 1$ = 80TK (stated in paper). Replacement costs not reported. Emission factors not reported (paper states system is 'no CO2 emissions & pollution free'). T_life (project lifetime) not explicitly stated. r (discount rate) not reported. p_grid not applicable (system configuration not clearly grid-connected or off-grid). A_PV not reported. Component lifetimes: life_WT from spec 'Life time: 20 year'; life_EL from spec 'Life Time: 20 yr'; life_DG from generator 'Operational life: 34 Yr'. life_H2, life_FC, life_INVT not reported. N_PV not reported (total capacity given). N_WT=14 from component spec. N_H2, N_FC, N_EL, N_DG not reported (single units each).
